t: Erbauer EXT 18V compact combi drill and impact driver set. Contains ERI1092COM and ERI1093IPD, featuring V2 brushless motors and delivering up to 35% more power, 25% faster speed and with a more compact design than the previous models. Convenient LED worklights. Combi drill also offers 75Nm torque and 3-in-1 quick function selection, with fast switching between screwdriving, drilling, and hammer drilling. 13mm metal chuck with lock accepts bigger sized bits and provides reliable grip force. Impact driver with a high torque of 220Nm also features 3 torque settings for precise torque control, a variable speed trigger and one-handed collet for easy one-handed bit insertion.
